HighSpaceUsageProtection.description_en:
Specifies whether to unconditionally clean up binary logs when the instance storage usage exceeds 90% or the remaining storage is less than 5 GB. Valid values:

1: enabled.
0: disabled
HighSpaceUsageProtection.description_zh:
当实例使用空间超过90%或剩余空间小于5GB时，是否开启无条件清理Binlog，取值范围如下：
1：开启 
0：不开启

LocalLogRetentionHours.description_en: The number of hours for which log backups are retained locally. Valid values: 0 to 168. A value of 0 indicates that log backups are not retained. Default value: 18
LocalLogRetentionHours.description_zh: 日志备份本地保留小时数，取值范围为0~168，0表示不保留，默认值为18

LocalLogRetentionSpace.description_en: The maximum storage usage of binary logs, in percentage. Valid values: 0 to 50. This is a circular space. Default value: 30
LocalLogRetentionSpace.description_zh: 本地日志最大空间使用率。 取值范围为0~50，此为循环空间，默认为30
